topic: Introduce a Painting, an Artist or an Art Style(介绍一幅画/一位艺术家/一种艺术风格)
genre: 说明文 / 介绍(introduce and describe a work of art, an artist, or a style)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 1 Reading for Writing 取向:写一篇介绍性短文,向读者介绍一幅画/一位艺术家/一种艺术风格,说明其背景、特点与你欣赏的理由。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,学校英语角要办一期'我最爱的艺术'专栏。请用英语写一篇约100词的短文,介绍你最喜爱的一幅画、一位艺术家或一种艺术风格,内容包括:① 它/他是谁、属于哪个时期或风格;② 这件作品(或风格)的主要特点;③ 你为什么喜欢它。注意:用不定式作表语点明主旨(如 The aim of this style is to … / My favourite hobby is …),行文连贯。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your school English corner is running a column called 'The Art I Love'. Write a short passage (about 100 words) to introduce your favourite painting, artist, or art style, including: 1) who or what it is, and which period or style it belongs to; 2) the main features of the work or style; 3) why you like it. Try to use the infinitive as the predicative (e.g. The aim of this style is to …).
points: 点明对象与时期/风格(This painting / artist / style belongs to …)
描述主要特点(Its main feature is … / The aim of this style is to …)
说明喜欢的理由(What I love most about it is …)
用不定式作表语、行文连贯、词汇地道
model_essay: My favourite work of art is Monet's painting Impression, Sunrise. It belongs to Impressionism, a style that emerged in France in the late 19th century. The aim of this style is to capture light, colour, and a single moment's feeling, rather than to make a precise record of a scene. In the painting, a few soft brushstrokes turn the harbour at dawn into something warm and alive. What I love most about it is the way it shows the world as the painter truly felt it. Every time I look at it, my own wish is to see ordinary things with fresh eyes.
model_translation: 我最喜爱的艺术作品是莫奈的《印象·日出》。它属于印象派——一种19世纪晚期在法国兴起的风格。这种风格的目标是捕捉光、色彩和某个瞬间的感觉,而不是精确记录一处场景。画中,几笔柔和的笔触把黎明的港口变得温暖而鲜活。我最喜欢它的地方,是它呈现出画家真正感受到的世界。每次看到它,我自己的愿望就是用全新的眼光去看寻常的事物。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:对象与时期/风格 / 主要特点 / 喜欢的理由
围绕一件作品(或风格)展开、句句相关、逻辑连贯
句型词汇准确多样、不定式作表语运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 点题 My favourite work of art is …
归类 It belongs to … , a style that …
特点 The aim of this style is to … / Its main feature is …
理由 What I love most about it is …
key_expressions: My favourite work of art is Monet's painting Impression, Sunrise.
It belongs to Impressionism, a style that emerged in France.
The aim of this style is to capture light, colour, and a single moment's feeling.
What I love most about it is the way it shows the world.

high_sentences: It belongs to Impressionism, a style that emerged in France in the late 19th century.
The aim of this style is to capture light, colour, and a single moment's feeling.
A few soft brushstrokes turn the harbour at dawn into something warm and alive.
What I love most about it is the way it shows the world as the painter truly felt it.

error_pairs.wrong: The aim of this style is capture light.
error_pairs.correct: The aim of this style is to capture light.
error_pairs.note: 主语 aim 是抽象名词,be 后用不定式作表语,需 to。
主语第三人称单数,动词加 s。

error_pairs.wrong: My wish is seeing things with fresh eyes.
error_pairs.correct: My wish is to see things with fresh eyes.
error_pairs.note: wish 后作表语表'要做的事',用不定式而非动名词。
